description: This Java class 'DeviceData' extends 'ProfileAwareData' and manages device attribute data, including maps for client and shared attributes, with methods to get, put, and remove attributes based on scope and key type.

classes.name: DeviceData
classes.description: A class representing device-specific data with attribute maps and methods to manage device attributes.

methods.name: DeviceData
methods.description: Constructor initializing the device data with a UUID and attribute maps.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is DEVICE.

methods.name: getAttr
methods.description: Retrieves a DataPoint attribute based on key ID and entity key type.

methods.name: putAttr
methods.description: Adds or updates an attribute in the appropriate map based on scope.

methods.name: removeAttr
methods.description: Removes an attribute from the specified scope map.

methods.name: getAttributeDataPoint
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a DataPoint from server, shared, or client attribute maps.
